result.reason: The operative language adopts New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts located in New York County, matching the preferred position. Replacing arbitration and deleting the related award-confirmation language are necessary to implement that court forum, while the severability provision and scope of covered disputes remain unchanged. The added consent-to-jurisdiction and venue-waiver language is appropriate. The only drafting blemish is the inherited sentence fragment beginning with subsection “(b),” which appears to result from incomplete source text rather than the redline.
